snippet.title: Silver Pines - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Silver Pines is a survival horror game set in small town America. Explore a haunting town, manage scarce resources and choose whether to fight or flee nightmarish horrors as you try to uncover the mysterious disappearance of Eddie Velvet.  

Releasing October 8th 2026. 
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
